_Fdata.__init__: Use to bundle your functional data matrix, evaluation grid, and metadata into a single object with method wrappers.
_Fdata.center: Use to subtract the cross-sectional mean from each observation before depth or PCA analysis.
_Fdata.depth: Use to rank observations by functional depth (e.g. Fraiman-Muniz) directly from the Fdata object.
_Fdata.to_pc: Use to decompose functional data into principal components (FPCA) and get scores and basis functions.
alignment.karcher_mean: Use when you need the Frechet/Karcher mean of a set of curves under elastic (SRSF) warping.
alignment.elastic_align_pair: Use to elastically align two curves by computing their optimal warp function via SRSF.
basis.basis_nbasis_cv: Use to select the optimal number of B-spline or Fourier basis functions via leave-one-out CV.
basis.basis_to_fdata_1d: Use to convert a coefficient matrix + basis object into a functional data matrix on a target grid.
clustering.kmeans_functional: Use for k-means clustering of functional data; returns cluster labels and centroids.
clustering.cluster_optim: Use when the number of clusters k is unknown and you want automatic selection via silhouette or BIC.
covariance.cov_surface_1d: Use to estimate the cross-sectional covariance surface C(s,t) for a functional dataset.
depth.fraiman_muniz_1d: Use to compute the Fraiman-Muniz depth (marginal-integral depth) for 1D functional data.
depth.band_1d: Use to compute band depth — the proportion of bands formed by sample curve pairs that contain a query curve.
depth.modal_1d: Use to rank curves by modal depth (kernel density in function space); identifies the most central curve.
fdata.mean_1d: Use to compute the pointwise cross-sectional mean curve of a functional dataset.
fdata.deriv_1d: Use to estimate the first or higher-order derivative of a functional dataset on its evaluation grid.
fdata.norm_1d: Use to compute the L2 (or Lp) norm of each functional observation.
frechet.frechet_global_reg: Use to run Frechet regression with a scalar or metric-space response and functional predictors.
fts.ftsm_fit: Use to fit a Functional Time Series Model (FTSM) for forecasting seasonal functional data.
fts.stationarity_test: Use to test stationarity of a functional time series before fitting FTSM or computing ACF.
inference.flm_f_test: Use to test whether functional linear model coefficients are jointly zero (functional F-test).
inference.bootstrap_confidence_band: Use to construct bootstrap confidence bands for a population mean or regression function.
regression.fregre_lm: Use to fit a scalar-on-function linear regression model via FPC basis expansion.
regression.concurrent_regression: Use to fit a concurrent (pointwise) functional regression model where response and predictor share the same grid.
scoring.pred_mae: Use to evaluate predictive accuracy of a functional regression model via mean absolute error.
simulation.kl_simulation: Use to simulate functional data via the Karhunen-Loeve expansion with given eigencomponents.
smoothing.nadaraya_watson: Use for nonparametric smoothing of noisy functional observations via Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression.
smoothing.gcv_smoother: Use when bandwidth selection is needed — GCV smoother selects optimal bandwidth automatically.
